Sub: Compliance Audit of Exempted Establishments—ST 
Sir, 
A comprehensive compliance audit of all the exempted/relaxed 
establishments (u/s 17(1)/ para 79 or para 27A) shall be undertaken by all officer-
in-charge of ROs/SROs during November and December, 2009. The audit shall 
cover the period till 31/03/09 and shall be carried out by a team headed by an 
RPFC-II/APFC. It shall be extended to all the establishments that are 
exempted/relaxed including those in respect of which the application of 
exemption is under process. A proforma (Annexure-I) enclosed herewith should 
be duly filled up by the squad after completing the compliance audit and the 
same should be submitted to their office for further necessary action. 
2)
All RPFCs-in-charge should ensure that the compliance audit is conducted 
in a time bound manner by forming sufficient squads to cover all the exempted 
establishments under their jurisdiction. 
3)
It is reiterated that the compliance audit is to be undertaken both in 
respect of the establishment as well as its P.F. Trust, hence thorough scrutiny of 
all the relevant records should be made before recording the observation in the 
proforma (Annexure-I). 
4)
During the last compliance audit it was noticed that, in some cases the 
compliance audit could not be completed as the establishment was participating 
in a trust which was located outside the jurisdiction of the concerned RPFC. It is 
therefore directed that in such cases either the trust records be called for or the 
RPFC in whose jurisdiction the said trust exists should be requested to audit the

You faithfully, 
(P. Sudhaka 
Additional Central P.F. Cornmissloner(C • 
ance) 
records of the P.F. Trust. Under no circumstances incomplete reports should be 
submitted by the squad. 
5)
As the format for Compliance Audit Report has been devised to have a 
clear status of an exempted establishment so as to confer and maintain a status 
of "exempted" upon the establishment pointed and pertinent queries have been 
raised in the said Annexure I. It is therefore directed that reply of each point 
should be specific, unequivocal and fact based. It should also be ensured that 
the Audit Report is duly authenticated by the signatures of all members of the 
audit team including the head functionary (RPFC-Il / APFC). It is further 
emphasized that whenever any deficiency / non-compliance is noticed the team 
should not issue clarification in order to dilute the matter and specific report 
should be made. The Officer-in-charge before sending the team should brief 
them thoroughly so that the purpose is achieved and the report becomes useful 
for all practical purpose. 
6)
The follow-up action on the compliance audit reports also needs to be 
initiated in the right earnest. In cases of violation of any of the conditions of 
exemption or default in the payment of dues/submission of returns, it should be 
ensured by the officer-in-charge that necessary action as per the Act & Scheme 
is initiated without any delay and developments reported to Head Office. 
7)
A number of cases for grant of exemption are pending in Head Office for 
want of Compliance Audit Reports. AII Officer-in-charge are directed to forward 
copies of compliance audit reports in respect of establishments pending for 
exemption alongwith the specific comments/recommendations of RPFC-I / 01C, 
SRO to Head Office. 
8)
After the completion of the compliance auditoa summarized information in 
Annexure-II be sent by 15/01/10.
